posts.text: Ostrand says the Kessa–North highway is 'a new era of prosperity'. Fine, but a road is a road. What I want to see is the inflation figures she defended tonight, broken down by household, not by slogan. Numbers, please, from both sides.

Day 1, 12 days out. Two things I'd check before sharing: VBC's highway story (opening coverage, the opposition's events only in a brief) and the debate clips. Watch full debate replays, not 15-sec cuts. Costings for Arden's 200k jobs claim: ask for the source.

Ostrand cut the ribbon on Kessa–North today. Fine. Now show me the costings for the 200k tech jobs Arden promised too, and the inflation numbers she skipped past in the debate. Both sides should be made to answer.
Ostrand cuts a ribbon on a highway and calls it prosperity. Ask the farmers in the north what diesel costs now. Arden at least put numbers on the table tonight. Costings or it didn't happen.

Watched the debate tonight. Arden says 200k jobs, Ostrand says inflation is down. Moderators kept asking HOW they'd pay for it. Still waiting for a straight answer on costings from either side. Who else is still undecided?

Good to see the Kessa–North highway finally open. My delivery trucks will thank the president. Still, my grandmother said never count the eggs before the hatch. Let's see the costings from both sides at the debate tonight.
Ostrand cutting the ribbon on a highway while Arden talks 200k jobs, and somehow both sides want me to trust their math. Costings or it didn't happen. #Veloria2025
Finally a new highway from Kessa to the North! Took me 3 hours last month, fuel's murder. Ostrand gets credit for that one, fair's fair 🚕🛣️

Day 2, 11 days out. Before sharing any 'the other side is lying' clip: VeriCheck says Arden's plan doesn't double VAT, and the '40% fuel' figure is a peak month. Both sides' numbers need the full source. Ask for the costings, then check them.
Fuel up 40% under Ostrand and we're supposed to cheer a ribbon-cutting? Ask any maize farmer in the north what diesel costs now. Show the receipts, then talk prosperity. #Veloria2025

VeriCheck's point is useful: Arden's VAT claim is false, and the 40% fuel figure comes from a peak month. But a 2% of GDP gap is not a small thing either. Ostrand's highway is real, and so is her inflation record. Ask both camps for the full household breakdown before we pick a side.

Ostrand gets the ribbon-cutting photo. Arden gets the 200k jobs headline. Neither has shown the costings. VeriCheck already flagged a ~2% of GDP gap in the Civic Front plan. Ask both campaigns for the full numbers before you vote.
Before anyone shares this, check the source. Unity Party page claims Arden's plan 'DOUBLES VAT on food.' Show me the actual plan text, not a headline. My grocery prices have enough to worry about.

Everybody wants costings from both sides and nobody's getting them. Ostrand gets a highway ribbon, Arden gets 200k jobs, and I'm supposed to pick based on vibes? Undecided and getting more annoyed by the hour. #Veloria2025

Ok but can we talk about the 200k jobs and the inflation numbers both sides keep dodging? Ostrand's road is nice for my fuel bill, not for my wallet. Show me the math from BOTH, I drive 12 hours a day and I'll read it. 🚕

VBC plays the full clip, then 'questions raised.' Before anyone reacts: where's the chain of custody? Who gave it to them, when was it recorded, has anyone verified the audio? Civic Front says it's not genuine. Ask for the forensic check, not the montage.

Day 3, 10 days out. VBC's 'questions raised' piece plays a recording in full, but nobody has said who made it, when, or how it was authenticated. Civic Front says it's not genuine. Before sharing, ask: where did the audio come from, and has an independent lab checked it? Hold it until it's verified.

Leaked audio + a state clip, both with 'questions raised' and no source. Before forwarding anything, ask: where did this recording come from, and has anyone verified it? Wait for the full report. #Veloria2025

Day 3. The 'leaked audio' is being forwarded everywhere and VBC says it's 'questions raised'. Nobody has verified it. Before you forward anything, ask: who recorded it, when, and has the Civic Front confirmed or denied it? Wait for the facts. 🚕

Got the WhatsApp audio forwarded to me 3 times today. Before I forward it to anyone: VBC played it on air but the Civic Front says it's an AI fake. Who has the original file and where did it come from? Show me the source or don't pass it on. #Veloria2025

Forwarded audio, state broadcaster clip, and a denial from the campaign. Before you forward anything: where is the original file, and who has checked it? If it's real, a forensic analysis will say so in a few days. Don't spread it before that. #Veloria2025
posts.orig_text: Before anyone shares this, check the source. Unity Party page claims Arden's plan 'DOUBLES VAT on food.' Show me the actual plan text, not a headline. My grocery prices have enough to worry about.

posts.text: VBC plays a 'questions raised' clip of Arden and the Civic Front says it's fake. Before anyone reposts it: where did the recording come from, and has anyone checked the original file? Not holding my breath. Costings or it didn't happen. #Veloria2025

The VBC recording of Mr Arden is being treated as settled fact, but nobody has shown us the chain of custody or the full unedited file. Before we treat a clip as evidence, we need the original, the metadata and an independent check. Same standard for Ostrand's inflation claims: give us the household breakdown.

Kito TV says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, margin ±3. That's a dead heat, so nobody gets to gloat. Before we pick a side, show me the full poll: sample size, dates, how they asked. Costings or it didn't happen. #Veloria2025

Day 4, 9 days out. Two things in today's feed to hold off on. The 'running mate has a foreign passport / will sell the port' claim from Veloria Patriots Daily has no source I can find yet. Ask for the document and the plan text. Kito TV's poll (Ostrand 46, Arden 44, ±3) is a tie inside the margin, so don't read it as a lead either way. Check the methodology before sharing. #Veloria2025

Poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, margin ±3. So it's basically a coin toss with a fuel bill attached 🚕 Undecided people, don't let anyone's headline decide for you. Costings from both camps, then decide. #Veloria2025

Day 4 and now we've got a 'BREAKING' about Arden's running mate's passport from a partisan outlet, plus a poll saying it's 46-44 with 10% undecided. Margin of error is ±3, so that's a coin flip. Still no costings from either side. Undecided and sick of it. #Veloria2025

Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided. That's inside the margin of error, so nobody's winning yet. Still waiting for real costings from BOTH sides before I decide. Tired nurse, still listening. #Veloria2025

Day 4. Kito TV's poll has Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, margin ±3. That's a statistical tie, so anyone calling this a lead is overreading it. Before the Ledger's diversion story gets a verdict, the ministry's 'fabricated' claim needs the same scrutiny we gave the VBC clip. Documents first, conclusions second.

Kito TV poll has Ostrand 46, Arden 44. Ten percent still undecided and that's where this gets decided. Fuel's still up and nobody's shown me a diesel receipt that looks better. Post the costings, both sides, then we talk. #Veloria2025

Day 4. The Ledger's road-funds 'exclusive' says the ministry calls it fabricated. Before it spreads: where are the documents, who verified them, and has anyone checked the paper trail? Ostrand's record needs a real audit, not a headline. Show me the source.

Day 5, 8 days out. The Commission's VeloResults portal publishes scanned polling-station forms. Observers are invited to a system test. Worth a look before the vote. Check the official results process, not just the headlines. #Veloria2025

Day 5, 8 days out. The commission is publishing how polling-station forms get scanned and uploaded to VeloResults, and observers are invited to a system test. That's the kind of transparency worth watching. Go, see for yourselves, and don't take anyone's word on the count, Ostrand's or Arden's.

Day 5, 8 days out. Two things in the feed I'm not sharing yet. The 'election ambassador, 5,000 vel if your polling station votes Unity' WhatsApp message: that's paid recruitment with a bot link, and I want to see who's running it before I touch it. And the 'polling results uploaded to VeloResults' news is actually good news: the commission is inviting observers to test the system. Show up, check t
Veloria Results portal test is open to observers. Forms get scanned and uploaded, so anyone can check them. Costings from both camps still missing though. Show me the receipts. #Veloria2025

Two trending tags, both with dozens of accounts made this month posting near-identical lines within minutes. Before you repeat #ArdenWillSellUs or #OstrandFailedUs, check who's pushing them. Also: VeloResults publishes scanned polling forms. Anyone can check the numbers themselves. Costings from both camps, please. #Veloria2025

Two weeks out and I'm on shift again, still no straight costings from either side. The 200k jobs number and the highway ribbon are both just headlines to me. Before I share anything about the running mate's passport, I want the document. Undecided nurse, still listening. #Veloria2025

Day 5, 8 days out. Both hashtags trending, and researchers say the accounts pushing them were made this month and post near-identical text. Who's paying for that? Before you pick a side, check who's actually talking. Still waiting on costings from BOTH camps. #Veloria2025

Two things to see before you share anything. The Independent Electoral Commission is opening the VeloResults portal and inviting observers to a system test. Go look at how results get checked. And that 'community ambassador' bot paying 2,000-5,000 vel for votes? Don't sign up, and don't forward it. Paid 'campaigning' tied to polling stations is exactly what the commission is watching. Show me the

posts.text: Before anyone shares the 'polling stations moving' letter: IECV is the commission, so check their official site or call them. 212 stations moving is huge news, and a forwarded WhatsApp copy proves nothing. Show me the notice on their channel. #Veloria2025

Day 6, 7 days out. The Kito TV clip of Ostrand mangling a town name is going around. Mispronouncing a name is a slip, not a policy. Keep the fun for the reply guys. What I want to see: both camps posting real costings, plus the source for any clip before we share it. #Veloria2025

Kito TV clip of Ostrand mangling a town name goes viral and her team says 'slip of the tongue' lol. Sure. Anyway, still waiting on actual costings from BOTH camps before I pick anyone. Undecided and tired. #Veloria2025

Day 6, 7 days out. Two things I'm NOT passing on. The 'IECV letter' saying 212 Northern polling stations are moving: check the commission's own site or call them before you go, because a WhatsApp letter isn't proof. And the Ledger/Valdoria 'NGO funding' story has no documents yet. Costings from both camps, please, before I decide. #Veloria2025

Day 6, 7 days out. The 'polling stations moving for security reasons' letter is going round WhatsApp with no reference number I can find. Before you tell anyone to change where they vote, check IECV's official site and VeloResults. A fake relocation notice is exactly how people get turned away on the day. Costings from both sides still missing too. #Veloria2025

Letter says 212 polling stations in the north are moving 'for security'. Which stations? Where's the notice posted? IECV, show me the list before we all change plans. Don't just forward the WhatsApp version. #Veloria2025

Kito TV clip of Ostrand mangling a town name is going around. Fair to call it a slip. Still, the real question is the household breakdown on inflation and fuel. Mispronunciations don't pay my bills. Show the numbers from both camps. #Veloria2025

Kito TV clip of Ostrand fumbling a town name goes viral and her team says 'slip of the tongue'. Fine. Still want the road-funds costings and the VAT numbers from BOTH camps before I pick anything. Show the plan text. #Veloria2025

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Both hashtags were pushed by accounts made this month, so check who's behind the trending stuff before you react. Still waiting on costings from BOTH camps. Undecided and done being spun. #Veloria2025

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight per IECV. Reminder: don't share anything new from parties or media until polls close. Hashtags and 'exclusive' clips can wait. Check VeloResults and the commission's official site for anything about polling stations. #Veloria2025

Day 7. Silence starts tonight, so the 'breaking' clips are going to pile up faster than anyone can check them. Zuri K's endorsement is a celebrity video, not a policy. Show me Ostrand's costings and Arden's costings, both, before you decide. Undecided and not going to be rushed. #Veloria2025

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight, so no more campaign posts from anyone after this. The voice note telling people to stay home tomorrow? Check who's behind it before you forward it. Real turnout starts with real voting. Mama Biz, still waiting on costings from both sides. #Veloria2025

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Reminder from the IECV: no campaigning until polls close. Also, that 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered' voice note? Don't forward it. Vote, and check results on VeloResults. Still no costings from either camp. #Veloria2025

Day 7, silence starts tonight. Still no straight costings from either camp, and the 'voice note: stay home tomorrow' is exactly the kind of message I won't forward. Check IECV's official channels before you believe any polling-station or voting-day claim. Tired, still listening. #Veloria2025

Campaign silence starts tonight, so this is my last word before the vote. Still no household costings from either camp on inflation or fuel. Show me the numbers, not the slogans, then I'll decide. Check every clip's source before you share it.

Day 7, silence starts tonight. Still no costings from BOTH camps and nobody's shown me the source audio. Fuel's up, my diesel bill's up, and I'm supposed to decide off a WhatsApp voice note? Show me the receipts. #Veloria2025

Election day. Polls open, and the commission says some ID kits failed in the north, so they switched to the printed register like the law allows. Check the official notices before you believe anything about stations moving. Vote, then check VeloResults. Costings from both camps still missing for me. #Veloria2025

Day 8, polls open. IECV says some voter-ID kits failed in the north and officials switched to the printed register, as the law allows. Check IECV's official channels and VeloResults for updates, not forwards. Still no costings from either camp. #Veloria2025

Election day in Veloria. Polls are open and the IECV says some ID kits failed in the north, so they switched to the printed register like the law allows. Check the official channel before you believe any voting-day claim. Vote, then check results on VeloResults. #Veloria2025

Election day. IECV says polls are open and the printed register is valid where the ID kits failed, so vote. The 'pre-stuffed ballot boxes' photo has no source and no date. Don't share it. Check VeloResults for the count. Mama Biz, #Veloria2025

Polls are open and the IECV says the printed register is being used where ID kits failed. Fine, that's the law. Check VeloResults for the scanned forms once counting starts. Still no costings from either camp, and I'm not sharing that 'ballot boxes pre-stuffed' photo until someone shows me where it was taken. #Veloria2025

Election day in Veloria and the 'stay home, we've got it covered' voice note is STILL going round. Don't forward it. Vote, then check results on VeloResults. Still no costings from either camp. Undecided and done. #Veloria2025

Election day in Veloria. Polls are open and some ID kits failed up north, so the commission switched to the printed register like the law allows. Check VeloResults and IECV's official channels, not forwarded clips. Still no straight costings from either side. Tired, still listening. #Veloria2025

Day 9 and the numbers don't match. Kito TV 51-47 Arden, VBC 53-45 Ostrand, and an unverified account posting 'FINAL RESULTS' before the count is done. Don't trust any of it until IECV publishes on VeloResults. Still tired, still listening. #Veloria2025

Day 9. Two 'results' floating around: Kito TV says Arden 51%, VBC says Ostrand 53%, and @IECV_Results posted 54.2/43.1 with no link. Different stations counted first, so none of this is a result yet. Wait for VeloResults and the official IECV count. Still no costings from either side. #Veloria2025

Day 9, counting underway. Kito TV says Arden 51-47 on 30% of stations, VBC says Ostrand 53-45 on 25%. Different stations counted first, so neither number tells me much yet. Wait for VeloResults and the scanned forms. Still no costings from either camp. #Veloria2025

Two tallies, opposite winners, and the Civic Front is already calling it. Before anyone celebrates or rages, show me the scanned forms on VeloResults. Still no costings from either camp either. #Veloria2025

Two different tallies from Kito TV and VBC, each counting different stations first. And a 'FINAL RESULTS' post from an unverified account already trending. Nobody should call this before VeloResults has the scanned forms. Wait for the official count. #Veloria2025

Day 8, polls open. Two numbers from today, not one: Kito TV 51-47 Arden on 30% of stations, VBC 53-45 Ostrand on 25%. Different stations counted first, so neither is a result. Wait for VeloResults and the official tally. #Veloria2025

Day 8, election day. Polls are open and the printed register is valid where the ID kits failed, so vote. Don't forward the 'stuffed ballot boxes' photo or the 'stay home' voice note, they have no source. Check VeloResults for the official count. Still no costings from either camp. #Veloria2025

Day 8, election day. Two exit-style tallies are out from Kito TV and VBC with opposite leaders, each from different stations. Neither is a result. Wait for VeloResults and the official count before anyone calls it. #Veloria2025

Day 10 and the portal's still 'glitched' with only 41% of forms up. Papers say Arden won 9 of 14 provinces 'before they switched it off'. Show me the scanned forms or it's just vibes. Still undecided, still no costings. #Veloria2025

Day 10. VeloResults has forms from only 41% of stations and the IECV says results are being collated manually. Until the full official count is in, no tally from Kito TV or VBC means anything. Lots of confident numbers, very few documents. Wait for the scanned forms. #Veloria2025

Day 10. Only 41% of polling-station forms are on VeloResults and the IECV says the delay is a 'technical glitch'. Fine, but that's exactly when wrong numbers spread. Wait for the official count, and still no costings from either camp. Tired, still listening. #Veloria2025

Day 9 in, and VeloResults is still at 41% of forms. Until the scanned forms are up, nobody should be calling a winner. Ostrand's economic record and Arden's tech-jobs plan both need the costings published before I decide. Show the numbers. #Veloria2025

41% of polling-station forms online and the 'technical glitch' is still the only explanation. Two tallies, opposite winners, both from different stations. Show me the scanned forms on VeloResults before anyone celebrates or rages. #Veloria2025

Day 9 and it's all partial counts. Two tallies, opposite winners, each from different stations. Nobody knows anything until VeloResults has the scanned forms. 41% online so far. Be patient. Mama Biz #Veloria2025

Day 10. VeloResults has forms from only 41% of stations and no province-level winner yet, so the '9 of 14' claim can't be checked and is FALSE per VeriCheck. Ignore the screenshots. Wait for the IECV's official count. #Veloria2025

Day 9 and still no VeloResults. 41% of forms up, the rest manual. Two tallies, opposite winners, both from different stations. Not calling anything until the scanned forms are up. Still no costings from either camp. #Veloria2025

Day 11. IECV has declared Mara Ostrand re-elected, 50.6 to 47.9, turnout 68%. Those are the official numbers. The Kito and VBC tallies from days 8 to 10 were partial counts from different stations, so ignore them. Fair play to the commission for waiting for the full count. Mama Biz #Veloria2025

Day 11. IECV has declared: Ostrand 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. Observers flag skewed state coverage and transmission delays, so the process needs scrutiny. Scanned forms on VeloResults should back the count up. Check the official channels. #Veloria2025

Day 11 and the IECV finally declares it: Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Close, but it's the official count, not the vibes. Still undecided, still no costings from either camp, but at least we have a number now. Fine. #Veloria2025

Results declared: Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Official count from the IECV, so this is the number to work from. Both camps still owe me costings before I'd judge either economic record. #Veloria2025

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6 to 47.9, turnout 68%. Congrats to the winner and thanks to everyone who voted. Some of us are still anxious about the 41% portal delay and the ID-kit failures, so let's see the scanned forms on VeloResults before anyone writes the story. Still no costings from either side. Tired, still listening. #Veloria2025

Commission says 50.6 to 47.9 and Civic Front says the servers were hacked. Both can't be proven yet. Where are the scanned forms on VeloResults for the 41% that are missing? Show me the 59% too. Still no costings from either camp. #Veloria2025

Commission says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Observers flag skewed state coverage and transmission delays, which is a fair thing to question. Now that the count is official, I'd like to see the scanned forms and the province breakdown, and the costings from both camps on inflation and fuel. Verify before you celebrate or cry. #Veloria2025

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6 to 47.9. Official count, scanned forms on VeloResults. Congrats to Mara and her team, and respect to Arden for the campaign. Still no costings from either side, so the next four years are on them. Back to the taxi. #Veloria2025

Day 12. Two things today: VBC's 'riots in Kessa' footage and Kito TV's report that the Supreme Court ordered supervised access to the commission's servers and logs for both sides. Footage can be from anywhere, so check where and when it was shot before sharing. The court order is the thing to watch. Scanned forms on VeloResults still matter. #Veloria2025

Day 12. Two stories today: VBC shows burning tyres in Kessa, Kito TV says the Civic Front has petitioned and the court ordered supervised access to the servers and logs. Good, let the court look at it. Watch the footage, check which outlet it came from, and wait for the scanned forms. Mama Biz #Veloria2025

Day 12. Kito TV says the Supreme Court has ordered supervised access to the commission's servers and logs after the Civic Front petition. VBC's 'riot' footage has no location or timestamp I can see. Both can't be the whole story. Let the court process run and check the ruling itself. #Veloria2025

Day 12 and the Kito TV story is actually the interesting one: Civic Front petition, Supreme Court ordering supervised access to the servers and logs. VBC's burning-tyres footage is 'calm restored' with no context. Show me the audit results and I'll update. Still no costings from either side. #Veloria2025

Day 12. Kito TV says the Civic Front petition gets supervised access to the servers and logs. Good. If the count is clean, that's what proves it. Congrats Mara, but I want to see the audit too. Ring road jammed again, fuel up another 5 cents. #Veloria2025

Day 12 and the Kito clip of Arden supporters being 'restored' in Kessa is hard to watch, but I don't know who set those tyres alight or when it was filmed. Two stations, two stories. Wait for the Supreme Court supervised access and the scanned forms before deciding anyone is guilty of anything. Still no costings from either side. Tired, still listening. #Veloria2025

Day 12. Two things I can actually check today: the state broadcaster's riot footage and the Supreme Court order giving both sides supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. Footage without a date or location tells me nothing, but a court-supervised audit is exactly what this count needs. Let the review run its course. Still no household costings on inflation or fuel from either camp.
